items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 93:1
items.html: The name seal [Chotam] indicates two discernments: first, that the one stamped is not the essence of the seal; and second, that there is no discernment, however thin, in the seal that will not be in the imprint from it. (Item 156).
